themes: Raws recovered most of last week's break into the US holiday on renewed speculative buying, which says the fund long was not flushed out and is still the swing factor in both directions.
Brazilian mill and grower hedging on the weak real keeps meeting rallies, so producer selling remains the cap while sugar still pays clearly over hydrous ethanol in the Centre-South.
Whites keep outperforming raws, holding the whites premium firm and supporting refinery demand for Brazilian raws on the March and May horizons.
The US domestic market stays firm after USDA's November production cuts but is walled off from No. 11, with softening user demand the risk later in the season.

items.title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 25th November 2026
items.takeaway: Speculative buying lifted raws back to their best level since before last week's break, with some Brazilian mill selling only briefly capping it; whites gained even more and both closed near the highs going into the US holiday.

items.title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 24th November 2026
items.takeaway: An inconclusive session: raws edged up as longs tried to steady the market, a late pop was sold into, the March/May inversion eased slightly and whites slipped; little change to the picture after the break.

items.title: US Sugar Prices Hold Firm as Demand Signals Soften
items.takeaway: US domestic cash trade is thin with users mostly covered for next year; sellers keep premiums because USDA's November cuts to US output and deliveries tightened stocks-to-use, though it stays inside the comfort band. Strong deliveries may partly be buyers forced to take contracted sugar, a setup for later destocking.

items.title: Futures and Market Data: 23rd November 2026
items.takeaway: Chart pack for the week of the break: raws fell hard in the last two sessions; the latest COT showed specs trimming but still holding a large net long, producers covering some shorts and end-users adding longs, with March and May open interest falling. The 2027 whites premium held broadly steady.

items.title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 23rd November 2026
items.takeaway: Raws bounced on short covering and fresh buying after Friday's slide, but mills and growers priced into the strength with the real near 6.0 per dollar, capping the rally; whites outperformed and the March whites premium widened.
